decisive_items: progressive, bilateral, painless swelling of the jaws
symmetrical enlargement of the mandible and maxilla
well-defined, multilocular radiolucent areas involving the mandibular bodies, angles, ascending rami, and the maxillary tuberosities
response.rationale: Classic pediatric cherubism presentation: symmetric painless bilateral jaw swelling with multilocular radiolucencies and no systemic or hematologic abnormalities.
